comment: Every row is Python except a row holding nothing but the fold marker (D6). Each block is its own region, opened by the empty first row or a `…` row and closed by the next `…` row, so an unclosed string in one block's context rows (the closing line of a docstring, say) never bleeds into the blocks below.

lonequote.comment: a row that is only a line number and a triple quote is the edge of a docstring listed as context; colour it as a string without opening one, so the rows below stay Python
